summary: Telefônica Brasil filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors declared Interest on Capital (IoC) of R$350 million gross (R$288.75 million net after 17.5% withholding), based on July 31, 2026 balance sheet. Per-share gross amount is R$0.10952537999, net R$0.09035843849. Record date is August 26, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC; payment by April 30, 2027. The IoC counts toward mandatory dividends for fiscal 2026, subject to shareholder approval in 2027. Amount may be adjusted for ongoing buyback activity. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation; the category reflects a dividend-like distribution.
